newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian base metals shed recent gains.
newsitem.headline: Indian base metals shed recent gains.

text.p: Base metals lost recent gains on Tuesday at the metal market with slack demand from industrial consumers and hit by a slide in world prices, dealers said.
Fear that state owned agencies may reduce selling prices for the base metals next month also dragged prices downward, they said.
Ready copper fell by 100 rupees to 12,300 per quintal while tin and nickel lost 200 rupees each, at 34,300 and 36,500 rupees per quintal respectively.
Aluminium was quiet at 7,250 rupees per quintal, zinc at 6,450 and lead at 4,450.
